name: Alloy Welding and Manufacturing Co., Inc.
old_description: We are a job shop with 85 years of experience in metal fabrication, placing the highest priority on quality workmanship and customer service.
about:
Alloy Welding & Manufacturing Co., Inc. operates from Bristol, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1937 by Delphis “Del” Frechette. The company began as a job shop producing fabricated metal parts and welding repairs for local industry, with Del designing and building much of its original equipment. The business remained operational through World War II and survived the 1955 Bristol flood before relocating to its current 233 Riverside Avenue address. Now in its third generation of family ownership, the firm is led by Darren Frechette, who assumed management in 2005.

The shop provides metal fabrication, welding (GTAW, GMAW, SMAW), waterjet cutting, handheld laser welding, and portable welding services, along with metal sales and design assistance. Its 14,000-square-foot facility houses a CNC water jet for versatile shape cutting and a handheld laser welder suited for thin materials such as stainless steel and titanium. The company handles fabrication, installation, and repair projects for a range of part sizes, though specific production volumes are not disclosed.

Customers span industrial manufacturers, schools, government agencies, hospitals, apartment complexes, military entities, general contractors, and individual clients. The company serves sectors including construction, medical, high-tech, and military, and deploys mobile welding trucks for on-site maintenance and repair work.

Alloy Welding emphasizes quality workmanship and customer service, maintaining an ISO 9001:2015 quality system and requiring OSHA-10 certification for all technicians. The firm promotes “precision parts without a premium price” and highlights quick turnarounds, a commitment to answering the phone directly, and a family-business culture intended to continue into a fourth generation.
